mechanism: Guanfacine's alpha-2 adrenergic agonist activity may impair sympathetic counter-regulatory responses to hypoglycemia, potentially masking hypoglycemic symptoms and reducing glucose mobilization.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely; educate patient on non-adrenergic hypoglycemia symptoms (diaphoresis, cognitive changes); consider alternative antihypertensive if recurrent hypoglycemia occurs.
